qualification: Pre-fix fvid_media::owned_mp4::Mp4Reader panicked with negation overflow on trun.data_offset == i32::MIN, silently accepted effective fragment sample description 0, contradictory trun flags (0x00_0004 + 0x00_0400), overlong trex/tfhd/tfdt boxes, missing/invalid mfhd headers, and zero/duplicate trex track IDs, failed on valid empty-leading-run per-traf continuity, and dropped initial moov/stbl samples while ignoring corrupt init stbl tables in hybrid fragmented files. Pre-fix baseline reproduced all defects and all 4 forced acceptance tests failed.

Updating crates/fvid-media/src/owned_mp4_impl.rs resolves negative trun.data_offset via unsigned_abs(), enforces effective description selection, mutually exclusive trun flags, exact trex/tfhd/tfdt/mfhd payload extents, unique non-zero trex track IDs, per-traf data cursor continuity, and initial moov/stbl validation and indexing across fvid_media::owned_mp4::Mp4Reader, probe_mp4, and decode_video.

All healthy controls across mp4-signed-offset (including 2 GiB virtual valid-min and valid-adjacent sparse fixtures), mp4-fragment-description, mp4-trun-flags, mp4-tfhd-defaults, mp4-multi-trun, mp4-mfhd-trex, and mp4-hybrid-fragments retain exact coded packets, sync flags, 50 Hz clocks, probe_mp4 metadata (duration=3 ticks / 60,000 us), and decode_video output (3 frames, 16x16, 0 errors), while all malformed/unsupported inputs refuse cleanly without panicking.

4 focused tests, 82 related MP4/HLS/VP9 integration tests, 15 fvid-media owned_mp4 unit tests, 41 minimal-configuration (--no-default-features) tests, offline fixture unittest, and full player build pass.

ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015, 8.8.3, 8.8.4, 8.8.5, 8.8.7, 8.8.8, and 8.8.12 govern fragmented MP4 headers, runs, and hybrid sample tables. All fixtures are pure synthetic offline VP9/fMP4 files requiring neither FFmpeg nor network access.
counting: One owned_mp4 fragmented MP4 validation and hybrid indexing parity fix (FVID-0185). No extra IDs for individual fixture suites or controls.
